title.zh: 答题助手 · 考试刷题

summary.zh: 答题助手，适用于考试、刷题、题库练习、单选与测验：盯住答题页面，把每道题的答案弹成顶部通知——先查本地题库（可导入 csv/xlsx/json/tsv，命中最快最准），没有就调模型。手机端（DSH Go 原生界面）与网页端都能用，两端都能导入题库。
summary.en: Exam / quiz helper: watches the question page and pops each answer as a heads-up notification — local question bank first (import CSV, XLSX, JSON or TSV), model fallback. Works in the DSH Go phone app and in the DSH Web UI, and both can import a question bank.
